attestations.text: LÜ Liu-liang 呂留良 (original ming 呂光綸 T. 莊生, 用晦 H. 晚村), Feb. 13, 1629–1683, Oct. 3, scholar, was a native of Ch'ung-tê, Chekiang, where his family had settled early in the twelfth century.
